name: tapa
description: 视窗 Tapa — 零猜测八邻环推理. 出题时由铅笔求解器实测：每一局都唯一可解、且只用线索自黑、环上相容、二乘二禁、白格连通和反证就能推到底, 难度分与档位区间都是量出来的.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && for f in tools/*.mjs tools/*.cjs tools/scenarios.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && bash -n tools/verify.sh && test -f index.html && test -f css/game.css && test -f js/data/library.js && grep -q '<canvas' index.html && grep -q 'js/main.js' index.html && echo OK

author: z-biz-game
